story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Statement views: summary (by bill) and detailed (by payment/event) 2. Export as TT200-compliant PDF/Excel, includes hash and legal footer 3. "Send to supplier" emails exported statement with delivery/audit logging 4. Import supplier-provided statement: parses/compares items, flags mismatches/missing/applied, supports manual notes and adjustment vouchers 5. History: all statements sent, viewed, exported stored per supplier; batch ZIP/email allowed (max size configured/audited) 6. Dispute log: reason/actioned/edited by AR/accountant; included in next export and in audit trail 7. Attachments: batch download ZIP per-statement; logs every download/email

constraints.constraint: Multi-Tenancy: All statement entities (SupplierStatementHistory, SupplierStatementDispute) must extend CompanyScopedEntity interface and implement company_id field. All queries must be filtered by CompanyContext.getCompanyId().

RBAC Enforcement: All authenticated users can generate and view statements (company-scoped), but export/email/reconciliation operations require appropriate permissions (Accountant, Chief Accountant, CFO). Use @PreAuthorize annotations at service and controller methods.

TT200 Compliance: Statement exports must follow TT200 format requirements including legal footer, SHA-256 hash generation for document integrity, and proper Vietnamese formatting (currency: #,##0.00₫, dates: dd/MM/yyyy).

Audit Logging: All statement operations (generation, export, email, import, reconciliation, dispute updates) must be logged via AuditService with action, user, timestamp, IP address, and change details.

Service Layer Patterns: Use @Transactional for data modifications, @Cacheable for read operations where appropriate, and @PreAuthorize for RBAC enforcement. Follow naming convention: SupplierStatementService with SupplierStatementServiceImpl in service/impl/ap/ package.

Database Design: Create new entities for statement history (SupplierStatementHistory) and dispute logging (SupplierStatementDispute) with proper indexes on supplier_id, company_id, generation_date, and status fields for query performance.

Export Patterns: Use Apache POI (XSSFWorkbook) for Excel generation with proper cell formatting and auto-sizing. Use text-based PDF generation for MVP (similar to aging reports). Include metadata (supplier, period, timestamp) and hash in exported files.

Email Integration: Log email requests via AuditService, integrate with actual email service when available. Track delivery status and recipients in SupplierStatementHistory entity. Support batch ZIP emails with configurable max size limit.

Reconciliation Logic: Use tolerance-based matching (default ±1,000₫ for amount differences). Categorize results as Matched, Mismatched, Missing, Applied. Create SupplierStatementDispute entries for mismatched/missing items with status tracking (OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED, REJECTED).

Frontend Structure: Create feature under features/accounting/pages/SupplierStatements/ following feature-first structure. Reuse existing DataTable components, export functionality, and dialog patterns from APAging components.

tests.standards: Follow testing patterns established in Stories 4.1-4.4: Use TestContainers with PostgreSQL for integration tests. Test all service operations with company-scoped data isolation. Verify RBAC enforcement at service and API levels. Test export functionality (Excel and PDF formats) with TT200 compliance. Test import and reconciliation logic with various scenarios (matched, mismatched, missing, applied). Verify dispute logging and resolution workflows. Test statement history tracking and batch operations (ZIP download, batch email). Validate email functionality (mocked for tests). Test audit logging for all operations. Use JUnit 5 for backend tests and Vitest + Testing Library for frontend component tests.

test.idea: Test statement generation for both summary (by bill) and detailed (by payment/event) views. Verify correct data aggregation, opening/closing balance calculation, and line-by-line bill items and payment events.

Test Excel export using Apache POI with proper formatting (header, summary table, detailed table, footer with hash and legal text). Test PDF export with TT200-compliant format and UTF-8 encoding for Vietnamese characters.
Test email functionality with statement attachment, delivery logging, and audit trail. Verify sent_date and sent_to fields updated in SupplierStatementHistory. Test batch email with ZIP archive.

Test statement import parsing (Excel/CSV), comparison with system bills, and mismatch detection. Verify categorization (matched, mismatched, missing, applied) with tolerance-based amount matching. Test manual notes and adjustment voucher generation.

Test statement history tracking with all generated/sent statements. Verify pagination, filtering by supplier/date range/status. Test batch ZIP download with max size limit enforcement and audit logging.

Test dispute log creation with reason, status transitions (OPEN → IN_PROGRESS → RESOLVED/REJECTED), resolution notes, and actioned_by tracking. Verify disputes included in next statement export if unresolved. Test full audit compliance.
Test batch download ZIP generation with multiple statements. Verify max size limit enforcement (configurable, default 50MB). Test download/email event logging with initiator and timestamp.

Test RBAC enforcement: all authenticated users can generate/view (company-scoped), but export/email/reconciliation requires appropriate permissions. Test multi-tenancy: verify all queries filtered by company_id and no cross-company data access.
Test audit logging for all operations: generation, export, email, import, reconciliation, dispute updates. Verify action, user, timestamp, IP address, and change details captured in audit log.
